title: [GMCP 203.034.06] Operations and evidence: Audit, privacy, provenance, and compliance evidence
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-034-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: A single tamper-evident event model records MCP lifecycle, discovery, policy, consent, install, auth, invocation, data egress, callback, task and administrative outcomes with correlation and provenance but no secret or raw sensitive payload. Retention, deletion, export and subject boundaries are configurable; completeness canaries catch bypasses; and an evidence bundle reproduces every completion claim from immutable test and build artifacts. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
